description: The signed-in person's style profile as Alama has written it from their wardrobe and what they wear: a short summary, one line each on palette, shapes, formality, materials and most-worn pieces, their style words, what they avoid and their usual sizes. Use it to answer 'what do you know about my style' or before recommending anything. Lines marked confirmed_by_person are in the person's own words. It is a description, not a rule: say so if the person disagrees, and tell them they can correct it in the Alama app.
name: style_profile

confirmed_by_person.description: True when the person wrote or corrected this line
confirmed_by_person.title: Confirmed By Person

garments_behind.description: How many of their garments support the line (all of them, not a sample); absent if unknown
garments_behind.title: Garments Behind

avoids.description: What they have said they avoid, in their words
avoids.title: Avoids

garments.description: Garments in the wardrobe it was written from
garments.title: Garments

getting_started.description: Set when the wardrobe is empty or nearly empty: what to tell the person and how they add clothes
getting_started.title: Getting Started

how_to_correct.default: The person can correct any line under Profile → Your style in the Alama app: tap it, then Edit or 'That's not me'. A line marked confirmed_by_person is in their own words; treat it as fact.
how_to_correct.title: How To Correct

palette.description: [{name, share}] by how much each is used
palette.title: Palette

status.description: ready, building (ask again in a minute) or not_enough_items
status.title: Status

title: My style profile
